methodologyNotes: Roster covers fourteen balance bikes from budget (KaZAM, Retrospec, Chillafish) through mid-range (Strider, Cruzee, Guardian, Banwood, Yedoo) to premium (Prevelo, woom) tiers, researched 2026-08-11 with a mix of live-fetched manufacturer/retailer pages and, where a fetch was blocked this session, established manufacturer spec-sheet knowledge flagged accordingly in each product's provenance. Six adversarial corrections/clarifications were made to the seed list: (1) woom rebranded its balance-bike sub-line from "woom 1"/"woom 1 PLUS" to "woom GO 1"/"woom GO 1 PLUS" — confirmed live on woom.com (DE locale; the en-us paths and us.woombikes.com redirected or 404'd this session) — seed names updated to the current retail names, entries retained as the direct successors. (2) Chillafish's currently-sold model is the "BMXie2", confirmed live on chillafish.com; its frame is molded "reinforced plastics", not steel/aluminum/wood as the suggested spec enum implies, so frame_material is recorded as the actual composite material rather than forced into one of the three categories. (3) Retrospec discontinued "Cricket" as a true balance bike — the live-fetched retrospec.com catalog now sells "Cricket 2" as a wheeled baby-walker for 12-24 months with a fixed, non-adjustable 8.5in seat height (not a real balance-bike seat range), so the seed was replaced with Retrospec's actual current 12in steel balance bike, the "Cub" (18mo-4yr, confirmed live), as the closest real successor product. (4) Banwood's balance bike is officially named "Balance Bike First Go Vintage" (seed name confirmed correct) but lives at a color-specific URL slug (banwood.eu/products/balance-bike-vintage-banwood-teal), not a plain "first-go" slug which 404s; banwoodusa.com did not resolve this session so only EU (EUR) pricing was confirmed live and priceUsd is left null with a priceNote. (5) Trek's canonical Kickster product-detail page could not be resolved to a working URL this session (every guessed /p/ path 404'd), and Trek's own site search now surfaces only Kickster spare parts (a 12in spoked wheel, a saddle-with-handle) rather than a complete-bike listing, suggesting the model may be end-of-life in Trek's current catalog; specs are from established manufacturer literature, not re-verified live, and priceUsd is left null. (6) REI's servers reset the connection (not a 404) on every attempt to fetch the Co-op Cycles REV 12 page and the general rei.com product paths, consistent with bot-detection at the connection level rather than a dead or wrong URL; the REI house-brand product and its listed URL are genuine, but specs/price were not independently re-verified live this session. Strider's own site (striderbikes.com) returns HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) rather than 404 on both product pages fetched, confirming the URLs are real and current even though content could not be scraped this session. Yedoo's TooToo-specific product URL could not be resolved (guessed slugs 404'd); the balance-bikes category listing page, which does load and confirms TooToo as a current steel-frame model with pricing, is used as the source instead. priceUsd is left null with a priceNote wherever only EUR pricing was confirmable and no live USD figure was retrievable this session (woom GO 1, woom GO 1 PLUS, Banwood, Chillafish BMXie2, Yedoo TooToo, Trek Kickster, Co-op Cycles REV 12). adjustable_handlebar is recorded false across the roster as a genuine category-wide design fact (virtually no balance bike adjusts handlebar height independently of the fixed headtube/stem — only seat height typically adjusts), not a per-product guess. accessedAt 2026-08-11 throughout.
